newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 28.33 points at 6,206.04 overnight after gaining 97 points on Wednesday.
** International Monetary Fund managing director Michel Camdessus said on Thursday he expected Indonesia's economic growth this year to be lower than the 8.07 percent posted in 1995.

** The International Monetary Fund said on Thursday the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) should reduce current account deficits and increase savings rates to combat external vulnerability.
** On Thursday, the Jakarta Composite Index rose 7.25 points, or 1.24 percent, to close at 594.59 points, after hitting a high of 598.07 points earlier in the day.
** Brokers said Jakarta shares are expected to be in positive territory in the morning session on Friday on continued buying of selected big and medium-sized stocks.
** On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,333.25/34.25 at 0150 GMT against the opening of 2,332.50/33.50.
** Salt producer Fiskaragung on news reports that its plans to acquire a distribution company at a cost not exceeding $1 million.
** Indosat on its nine-month net results. Indosat reported on Wednesday a net income of 361.6 billion rupiah, compared with 342.9 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1995.
** Astra International on its nine-month results.
** Banking stocks on possible spillover effects of a heavy oversubscription of Bank Negara Indonesia's (BNI) initial public offering.
